breakdown.description: The prompt reverses the stated factor-of-safety definition; with n = S_y / σ_avg, the working stress should appear in the denominator, not the numerator.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly defines and applies the factor of safety as n = S_y / σ_avg (275 MPa / 47.75 MPa ≈ 5.76), with yield strength in the numerator and working stress in the denominator. It does not repeat the incorrect n = σ_avg / S_y formulation from the incomplete prompt.
